moments.title: Strictly's First Couple Eliminated, Next Show Looms
moments.blurb: Chris Appleton and Amy Dowden were the first couple to leave Strictly Come Dancing 2026 after the Movie Week dance-off on Sunday, with the remaining 14 couples returning to the ballroom on Saturday.

angles.name: Elimination Fallout
angles.copy: Still reeling from the first Strictly Come Dancing elimination? Chris Appleton and Amy Dowden said goodbye after Movie Week. Was it the right decision?

angles.name: Anticipation for Next Week
angles.copy: The glitterball drama continues! After the first elimination, who are you rooting for next week on Strictly Come Dancing? The remaining couples hit the floor Saturday.

moments.title: Taylor Swift Dominates UK Charts
moments.blurb: Taylor Swift has achieved a rare UK chart double, with 'Patient Zero' debuting at number one on the Official Singles Chart and 'The Life of a Showgirl' returning to number one on the Official Albums Chart.

angles.name: Singles & Albums #1
angles.copy: Taylor Swift is unstoppable! 'Patient Zero' is the UK's new #1 single, and 'The Life of a Showgirl' is back at #1 album. Queen of the charts!

angles.name: Chart Domination
angles.copy: It's a Taylor Swift takeover! With 'Patient Zero' at #1 and two other tracks in the top 5, plus a #1 album, she's owning the UK charts this week.

angles.name: Brian Johnson's Legacy

moments.title: Catherine Zeta-Jones Returns in 'Kill Jackie'

source.l: Woman & Home / The British TV Place

angles.copy: Catherine Zeta-Jones is back on our screens in the new Prime Video thriller 'Kill Jackie'! Even better, parts were filmed in her beloved Swansea.

angles.copy: Looking for your next binge? 'Kill Jackie', starring Swansea's own Catherine Zeta-Jones, is streaming now on Prime Video. Get stuck in!

moments.title: Lionesses Begin World Cup Play-Off Campaign
moments.blurb: England Women kick off their FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 play-off campaign this Friday, October 9th, with an away leg against Greece, followed by the home leg on October 13th.

angles.name: Big Week for England Women

moments.title: Cymru Women in World Cup Play-Offs
